parties.petitioner: Union Of India thr. I.O. Narcotics Control Bureau

summary: Compensation for wrongful detention; jurisdiction under Section 439 CrPC; bail power limited to liberty, not ancillary relief; re-testing samples after negative result; Thana Singh guideline; compensation not maintainable in bail proceedings; NLPS Act Section 69 protection; malafide vs bona fide investigation; High Court exceeded jurisdiction; impugned order set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 s.8(C), s.21, s.29, s.69
Thana Singh v. Central Bureau of Narcotics
Kalyan Chandra Sarkar v. Rajesh Ranjan
Rudal Sah v. State of Bihar
Nilabati Behera v. State of Orissa
D.K. Basu v. State of West Bengal
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court's direction to pay compensation quashed; impugned order set aside.
